zh.title: 台灣三大國籍航空同意取消一線人員名牌全名揭露
zh.summary: 華航長榮與星宇同意取消一線人員名牌全名揭露；工會指近四成人員曾遭騷擾。
body: 桃園市空服員職業工會表示，中華航空、長榮航空與星宇航空已陸續同意取消一線人員工作名牌的全名揭露，改以其他識別方式保護員工隱私。工會先前發起調查顯示，近4成空地勤人員曾因名牌揭露全名而遭受騷擾，逾98%人員支持取消全名揭露。
根據各公司調整方案，中華航空自8月26日宣布，將改以中英文姓氏搭配英文名縮寫或外文別名呈現，預定116年3月起換發，華信航空比照辦理。星宇航空於9月2日同意調整呈現方式，細節待定。長榮航空則於9月17日發布公告，預計116年上半年換發改為姓氏搭配人事代號的名牌。

en.title: Taiwan Airlines Agree to Remove Full Names from Frontline Staff Name Tags
en.summary: Taiwan airlines agree to drop full names from frontline staff name tags following union privacy survey.
body: The Taoyuan Flight Attendants Union stated that China Airlines, EVA Airways, and STARLUX Airlines have agreed to stop displaying frontline employees' full names on name tags to protect personal privacy. A survey conducted by aviation unions revealed that nearly 40 percent of cabin and ground staff experienced harassment due to full-name disclosures on tags, with over 98 percent supporting the policy change.

Under the updated plans, China Airlines will display surnames alongside first-name initials or aliases starting in March 2027, with Mandarin Airlines following the same approach. STARLUX Airlines agreed to adjust name tags with details to be finalized. EVA Airways announced it will reissue name tags in the first half of 2027, featuring employee surnames combined with staff ID numbers.

zh.title: 中華航空擴增高雄航網 高松包機啟航並加碼日韓航線
zh.summary: 華航高雄飛高松包機啟航；沖繩增為每日1班；10月加開首爾金浦
body: 中華航空強化南台灣航網布局，於2026年9月17日正式啟航高雄至高松的獨家包機航線。該包機每週一、四、六飛航，提供南部旅客直飛日本四國地區的觀光選擇。
同時，中華航空自9月17日起將高雄至沖繩的定期航線增班為每日1班。此外，業者計畫於10月1日起新增高雄至首爾金浦航線，每週二、四、六營運，結合現有高雄至首爾仁川每週4班，屆時每日均有前往韓國的航班。
中華航空表示，最新A321neo客機已進駐高雄，配置豪華經濟艙與經濟艙兩種艙等服務，主要執飛馬尼拉與沖繩定期航線，以及高松包機任務。

en.title: China Airlines Launches Kaohsiung-Takamatsu Charters and Expands Asian Routes
en.summary: China Airlines launched Kaohsiung to Takamatsu charters; increased Okinawa flights to daily; adds Seoul Gimpo route.
body: China Airlines launched its exclusive charter service between Kaohsiung and Takamatsu on September 17, 2026. Operating three times a week on Mondays, Thursdays, and Saturdays, the charter flights provide direct air connectivity from southern Taiwan to Japan's Shikoku region.

The carrier also expanded its Kaohsiung to Okinawa route to a daily frequency starting September 17. Furthermore, China Airlines plans to introduce a new service between Kaohsiung and Seoul Gimpo on October 1, operating three weekly flights on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays. Combined with four weekly flights to Seoul Incheon, China Airlines will offer daily flights between Kaohsiung and South Korea.

According to China Airlines, Airbus A321neo aircraft stationed in Kaohsiung offer premium economy and economy cabin configurations. The aircraft serve regular flights to Manila and Okinawa, as well as the Takamatsu charter flights.

zh.title: BermudAir將引進E190F貨機成為美洲首家營運商
zh.summary: BermudAir租賃一架E190F客改貨機，將成為美洲首家營運商。
body: 總部位於百慕達的航空公司 BermudAir 已與美國租賃公司 Regional One 簽署協議，將租用一架改裝的巴西航空工業E190客改貨客機（E190F），成為全球第二家、也是美洲首家引進此機型的航空公司。
巴西航空工業與 Regional One 於2026年9月16日證實此消息。BermudAir 目前擁有兩架 E175 與兩架巴西航空工業E190（ICAO機型代碼E190）客機，航點覆蓋加勒比海、美國和加拿大。該航空公司計畫利用這架結構載重可達13.5噸、貨艙容積約103立方公尺的貨機，在其現有區域網路中載運快遞貨物、電子商務及具時效性的物資。

en.title: BermudAir to Become First Embraer E190F Operator in the Americas
en.summary: BermudAir will lease an Embraer E190F from Regional One to launch cargo flights in the Americas.
body: Bermuda-based carrier BermudAir is set to become the world's second operator of the Embraer E190 freighter (E190F), and the first in the Americas. This development follows a lease agreement signed with US-based lessor Regional One for a single converted aircraft.

According to announcements by Embraer and Regional One on September 16, 2026, the converted freighter offers up to 13.5 tonnes of structural payload and approximately 103 cubic meters of cargo volume. BermudAir, which currently operates two passenger E175s and two Embraer E190 (ICAO type code E190) aircraft, plans to deploy the freighter for express cargo, e-commerce, and time-sensitive shipments across its network in the Caribbean, the United States, and Canada.

zh.title: 西捷航空與Tim Hortons合作 推出機上特製咖啡
zh.summary: 西捷航空結盟Tim Hortons；將於機上提供特製航空調配咖啡
body: 加拿大航空業者西捷航空（WestJet）與著名餐飲品牌 Tim Hortons 宣布達成全新合作夥伴關係。雙方在此次合作中推出專為航空環境打造的特製咖啡配方，計畫在機上服務中提供給搭機旅客享用。
根據航空新聞平台 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 17 日發布的報導，這項全新合作夥伴關係將使西捷航空的乘客得以在機上品嚐這款特製航空調配咖啡。該項合作結合了西捷航空的客運服務與 Tim Hortons 的特製咖啡，為搭乘該航空公司航班的旅客提供特色飲品選擇。

en.title: WestJet Partners With Tim Hortons to Offer Bespoke Aviation Coffee
en.summary: WestJet partners with Tim Hortons to serve passengers a bespoke aviation coffee blend.
body: Canadian air carrier WestJet has entered into a new partnership with Tim Hortons to offer a specialized beverage option on board its flights. Under the newly announced agreement, airline passengers will gain access to a bespoke aviation coffee blend crafted specifically for consumption during flight operations.

According to a report published by Simple Flying on September 17, 2026, the collaboration connects the airline with the popular brand to enhance the passenger experience. The custom coffee blend is tailored for in-flight service, allowing travelers flying with WestJet to enjoy the bespoke beverage while on board.
